input.quote: a. Grant. TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement.
input.rationale: The grant runs to Client only: neither affiliates nor contractors acting on our behalf are named, and there is no written-notice mechanism to add them, so the clause fails even the fallback position. The licence is not revocable at Vendor's discretion (it runs until termination under the term/termination provisions), which is acceptable, but §15 conditions transfer on the other party's consent with only an affiliate carve-out and no successor/M&A exception, which is the second fallback element. Minimal redline extends the grant to our affiliates and contractors and adds a mutual successor-transfer carve-out; the fallback (affiliates on written notice) is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Extend licence grant to Client affiliates and contractors and permit transfer to a successor
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the grant to cover our affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, since our origination and underwriting operations are run through affiliated entities and outsourced processors. We have also confirmed that either party may transfer the Agreement to a successor in a merger or sale of substantially all assets; if you prefer, we can instead cover affiliates on written notice to TrueLink.

ops.oldText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface
ops.newText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client and its affiliates and contractors acting on Client's behalf a non-exclusive license to use the Interface

ops.oldText: except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate or to a successor in connection with a merger, consolidation, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of the assigning party's assets or equity.
